title: Expression and Purification of HIS-tagged WIPI4
author: Elisabeth Holzer
materials: Analyze elution fractions via SDS-PAGE and Coomassie staining.

steps.title: Clone gene into bacmid
steps.instruction: Clone the codon‑optimized WIPI4 gene into a baculoviral expression vector, transform DH10EMBacY cells (Geneva Biotech), and verify the bacmid DNA by PCR.

steps.title: Transfect Sf9 with bacmid
steps.instruction: Transfect 1 × 10⁶ Sf9 cells in a 6‑well plate with 2500 ng purified bacmid DNA mixed with FuGENE HD transfection reagent.

steps.title: Generate initial virus V0
steps.instruction: Infect 40 mL Sf9 cells (1 × 10⁶ cells/mL) with the transfected culture, incubate for 168 h at 27 °C while monitoring for cytopathic effect (CPE) and yellow fluorescence; upon CPE harvest the supernatant as the initial viral stock (V0).

substeps.instruction: Infect 40 mL Sf9 cells (1 × 10⁶ cells/mL) with V0
Monitor for CPE and yellow fluorescence

steps.title: Amplify virus to V1
steps.instruction: Infect 40 mL Sf9 cells (1 × 10⁶ cells/mL) with V0, monitor for CPE; when CPE appears, centrifuge the culture, collect the supernatant as amplified virus stock (V1), and store V1 at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Infect 40 mL Sf9 cells (1 × 10⁶ cells/mL) with V0

steps.title: Prepare frozen cell pellets
steps.instruction: Wash cells once with PBS, flash‑freeze the pellets in liquid nitrogen, and store them at –80 °C until purification.

steps.title: Large‑scale infection with V1
steps.instruction: Infect 1 L Sf9 cells (1 × 10⁶ cells/mL) with 1 mL V1 virus, monitor cell viability, and harvest cells when viability drops to 90–95 %.

substeps.instruction: Infect 1 L Sf9 cells (1 × 10⁶ cells/mL) with 1 mL V1

steps.title: Harvest and filter supernatant
steps.instruction: Filter the harvested supernatant through a 0.45 µm filter.

steps.title: Resuspend and sonicate cells
steps.instruction: Thaw frozen pellets on ice, resuspend in 40 mL ice‑cold lysis buffer, and lyse by sonication 4 × 30 s at 60 % amplitude with cooling on ice.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend in 40 mL ice‑cold lysis buffer
Sonicate 4 × 30 s at 60 % amplitude on ice

steps.title: Clarify lysate
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the lysate at 20 000 rpm, 4 °C for 1 h using a Beckman Coulter TI45 rotor and collect the supernatant.

substeps.instruction: Centrifuge at 20 000 rpm, 4 °C for 1 h (Beckman Coulter TI45 rotor)

steps.title: Concentrate protein fractions
steps.instruction: Pool fractions containing the target protein and concentrate them using a 10 kDa cut‑off Amicon Ultra filter.

steps.title: His‑Trap purification
steps.instruction: Equilibrate a 5 mL HisTrap HP column with water followed by Buffer A; load the clarified lysate; wash with three column volumes of Buffer A; elute bound protein with a stepwise imidazole gradient (30, 75, 100, 150, 225, 300 mM) by increasing the proportion of Buffer B.

substeps.instruction: Equilibrate column with water then Buffer A
Wash with 3 column volumes of Buffer A
Elute with stepwise imidazole gradient (30‑300 mM) by increasing Buffer B

steps.title: Pool, concentrate, freeze
steps.instruction: Pool the eluted fractions, concentrate, aliquot, snap‑freeze in liquid nitrogen, and store at –80 °C.

steps.title: SEC purification
steps.instruction: Further purify the concentrated sample by size‑exclusion chromatography using a Superdex 200 Increase 10/300 GL column equilibrated in SEC buffer.
